For example, earlier example with "受贿" for officials. Also sometimes "受贿;滥用职权". The facts: he used his position to provide help in loan business, receiving money. That's bribery. They likely want "受贿罪". Possibly also "滥用职权罪". But typical charge for bank officials receiving bribes is "受贿罪". In Chinese criminal law, public officials who accept bribes for using their position is "受贿罪". The abuse of power is separate if they also commit acts beyond. But the facts only mention receiving bribes for loan assistance. So answer: [罪名]受贿<eoa>.
